name: PAL Robotics TIAGo Pro (single arm)
summary: The single-arm version of the TIAGo Pro indoor mobile manipulator: one 7-DoF arm (3 kg), lifting torso, omnidirectional base.

germany.statusNote: EU maker (Barcelona, Spain) that sells directly to customers across Europe on quote; no German distributor found and no public price.

sellers.name: PAL Robotics
sellers.note: Sells directly from Barcelona; quote request on the product page.

specs.label: Horizontal reach
specs.conditions: As stated by maker (workspace span); vertical reach 0.92 m

specs.label: Computer
specs.value: Intel i5, 16 GB RAM, 512 GB SSD; i7 and NVIDIA Jetson upgrades

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: 2x 360-degree LiDAR (10 m), RGB-D head camera, 4-mic array, torque sensing in every arm joint

specs.label: Software
specs.value: Ubuntu LTS RT, ROS 2, MoveIt 2, Nav2, ros2_control, Docker image with PAL SDK, MuJoCo and Gazebo models

notes: Omnidirectional base with 4 mecanum wheels; built for indoor floors.
Default end effector is the PAL parallel gripper; Allegro 16-DoF hand with tactile fingertips available as option.
Arms absorb impact energy and have joint brakes for work near people.
roughGround, stairs and outdoor set to false: mecanum base for indoor use.
